contact.basis: Fixed southwest principal front approach six metres outboard of original front plane before field and model geometry. True urban grade/entry threshold not surveyed.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Hong Kong General Post Office frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.3.125m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; exact post office approach/urban grade classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
